requirements.title: OUTPUT_UNIT identifies the asterisk WRITE and PRINT preconnected output unit
requirements.definition: OUTPUT_UNIT is a default integer scalar constant identifying the same preconnected sequential formatted output unit as asterisk WRITE, and PRINT uses that unit; its value is not -1. The named unit is therefore open, formatted, and sequential at program start.

pending.OUTPUT_UNIT-default-integer-scalar: Assign OUTPUT_UNIT to an integer initialized to -777; assert KIND(value)==KIND(0) and RANK(value)==0. Mutate the imported name to INPUT_UNIT.
pending.OUTPUT_UNIT-not-negative-one: Assert OUTPUT_UNIT /= -1 with OUTPUT_UNIT stored in an integer sentinel initialized to -777. Mutate the comparison to OUTPUT_UNIT == -1.
pending.OUTPUT_UNIT-same-as-asterisk-write-and-p: Capture standard output from a program that writes exact records "ou-explicit", "ou-star", and "ou-print" using WRITE(OUTPUT_UNIT,'(A)'), WRITE(*,'(A)'), and PRINT '(A)' respectively; assert the three records appear in that order. Mutate OUTPUT_UNIT to ERROR_UNIT.
pending.OUTPUT_UNIT-opened-formatted-sequential-: Initialize opened=.FALSE., form and access as CHARACTER(LEN=20) filled with '#', then execute INQUIRE(UNIT=OUTPUT_UNIT, OPENED=opened, FORM=form, ACCESS=access). Assert opened is .TRUE., LEN(form)==20, form=='FORMATTED           ', LEN(access)==20, and access=='SEQUENTIAL          ', with OUTPUT_UNIT /= -1 checked in the companion facet. Mutate UNIT=OUTPUT_UNIT to an unconnected scratch-selected unit number guarded by INQUIRE(EXIST=).

requirements.title: The numeric value of OUTPUT_UNIT is processor dependent
requirements.definition: The external unit number identified by OUTPUT_UNIT is processor dependent apart from the required -1 exclusion and identity with asterisk WRITE and PRINT.
